A stunning unique one bedroom apartment split over 2 floors and located on the third floor of this purpose built building.

This property benefits from natural wooden floors which have been recently restored and a real brick wall in the bedroom giving it an abundance of character and charm. As you enter the property there is a small hallway which has a tall white bookshelf on the right hand side. In front of the bookcase there is a staircase with white wooden banister leading up to the open plan kitchen and living area. As you follow the corridor round to the left there is a door on the left which leads into a fully tiled white modern bathroom with a bath and a shower. Straight ahead is the lovely good sized double bedroom with the already mentioned natural brick wall, a double bed and a set of charming white furniture to include a tall chest of drawers, bedside tables and a triple and single wardrobe. There is also a good sized storage cupboard under the stairs which currently contains the washer/dryer, ironing board and vacuum cleaner.

Upstairs there is a large open plan lounge area with a contemporary three seater sofa bed, 2 black leather armchairs and a dark wooden sideboard with a television. There are double doors to one side of the living area which lead out onto a lovely little balcony with stunning views of the Gherkin and City of London. On the other side of the living area there is a bright red and wooden fully fitted and furnished kitchen. It is fully equipped with a a gas hob and oven, microwave, dishwasher and all other necessary kitchen appliances. This property not only oozes character with its unique period features and bright spacious feel but is also situated in a great location with everything you need at your fingertips. The hustle and bustle of Brick Lane is just moments away and the City is within a short walking distance. This property is the ideal home for a working couple looking for somewhere convenient and homely to live in.

The nearest underground is Aldgate East station which is only minutes from the flat and provides access to the Hammersmith & city and district lines and also Liverpool Street station is only 10 minutes away.
